subject: LIT
title: Literature in English – Form 1
source: Annual progression sheet (titled 2026-27, weeks dated 2024-25), 2 h/week; dates moved to 2026-27 by week number

chapters.title: Module 1: Exploring oral African prose forms for entertainment and education

lessons.title: Presentation and class rules; the concept of literature, literary terms, classification of oral literature
Prose forms of oral literature: folktales, myths, legends
Elements and characteristics of prose: theme, style, character and characterisation
Reading and analysis of a prose text

chapters.title: Module 2: Exploring oral African drama forms for entertainment and education

lessons.title: Dramatic forms of oral literature: rituals, incantations, invocations
Characteristics and elements of drama; forms of drama (comedy, tragedy, tragi-comedy)
Reading and analysis of a drama text

chapters.title: Module 3: Exploring oral African poetic forms for entertainment

lessons.title: Poetic forms of oral literature: riddles, songs, proverbs
Characteristics and elements of poetry; types and forms of written poetry

chapters.title: Module 4: Literary creativity – producing literary works

lessons.title: Literary creativity: composing and singing songs from poems; writing poems
Literary creativity: miming, clowning, street pop, comedy
